Select distinct molecule identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for compounds mentioned in document CHEMBL5728629. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtered by chembl_id. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
